title: Siri
hint: Create an Assistant Token for each device that talks to your lists by voice. A token can add to your lists and read your Pantry and Shopping List to answer questions, and nothing else; revoke it here to stop it right away.

reveal.title: Copy your token now
reveal.hint: This is the only time it is shown. Paste it into the Shortcut when asked.

loadFailed: Your tokens could not be loaded.
revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Anything using it stops working.

setup.title: Set up Siri
setup.create: Create a token above and copy it.
setup.add: Add the “Pantry add” Shortcut to the Shortcuts app.
setup.paste: Paste the token when the Shortcut asks for it.
setup.say: Say “Hey Siri, Pantry add”, then say what to add.
setup.language: Siri’s phrase is always English, but you can say the items in any language Pocket Pantry supports.
setup.check: To ask what is in your Pantry, say “Hey Siri, Pantry check”. “Pantry add” answers questions too.
